# onecheck

> Simple, scriptable health checks for a server: YAML rules, cron, exit codes, result files and an event queue.

## Docs

- [onecheck](https://alekzonder.github.io/onecheck): Simple, scriptable health checks for a server.
- [Getting started](https://alekzonder.github.io/onecheck/getting-started)
- [Configuration](https://alekzonder.github.io/onecheck/configuration)
- [Checks](https://alekzonder.github.io/onecheck/checks)
- [State and events](https://alekzonder.github.io/onecheck/state-and-events)
- [Output and results](https://alekzonder.github.io/onecheck/output-and-results)
- [Module management](https://alekzonder.github.io/onecheck/module-management)
- [Logging and logrotate](https://alekzonder.github.io/onecheck/logging-and-logrotate)
- [Module protocol](https://alekzonder.github.io/onecheck/module-protocol)
- [Development](https://alekzonder.github.io/onecheck/development)

- [file module](https://alekzonder.github.io/onecheck/modules/file)
- [http module](https://alekzonder.github.io/onecheck/modules/http)
